completion_data.completion_summary: Added migrate-state-legacy-fields.sh to agent-system/extensions/core/manifest.json's provides.scripts and refreshed the core README's stale script count (27 -> 200). Resolved two unanticipated side effects (sibling task 324's undeployed source edit and a transient self-caused orphan file) via a standard non-destructive deploy-headless.sh redeploy, bringing verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow to a full PASS (33/33, 0 failures).

memory_candidates.content: check-extension-docs.sh's Rule O (declared-but-undeployed script) is an ADVISORY only, but verify-deploy.sh gate 5 (verify.lua's manifest-driven category parity check) treats the identical condition as a hard FAIL with no exemption. A plan that declares a script in provides.scripts while deliberately deferring its deployment (an explicit Non-Goal) must account for gate 5, not just check-extension-docs.sh's ADVISORY — otherwise the fix trades one gate's FAIL for another's.

deploy-headless.sh's default mode is a non-destructive resync of the gitignored .claude/ deploy tree from the source store, safe to run mid-task when verify-deploy.sh/check-extension-docs.sh report drift caused by a just-committed source-store edit (yours or a concurrent sibling's) that hasn't been redeployed yet. It creates no git commits and touches no git-tracked files, so it never conflicts with commit-scope rules.
